headline: Walk-in sales of $4,198 on 513 transactions across 18 open days
notes: Walk-in sales were up 50% on September ($2,790) and 14% on August ($3,692)
Museum guests on cafe open days rose 62% (2,239 to 3,627). Excluding NMWA staff, about 11% of guests bought from the cafe, up from 10% in September
Regular days averaged $203 and 25 transactions, against $128 and 16 in September
NMWA staff made 121 purchases ($807, 19% of walk-in sales) and members 15 ($162, 4%), against 97 and 7 in September
39 visitors came in for the cafe only, without a museum ticket (35 in September)
